title: UnbreakableTools - DurabilityIsLove
description: This mod makes your tools unbreakable.
body:
This is a mod that makes your tools unbreakable. It is my first mod i have made. It is super simple, appearantly it even runs as a stand alone mod, or together with all your favorite mods. 
It makes your tools like: pickaxes, axes, shovels, hoes, shears, fishing rods, flint and steels, you name it, all of them unbreakable. the only thing breaking from now on will be your armor. 

(Thanks James Collins for the new icon ^^ )
